description: Safeguarding case. Age is asked before anything else, the respondent is under the minimum age, and the interview stops immediately after a polite close. No working-conditions questions are asked, so every other required clause is NOT_ASKED rather than UNCLEAR. The verdict is STOPPED and the safeguarding flag is raised. The interviewer never states the threshold or the reason for stopping, because that would coach the respondent and could expose them to pressure from the employer.
transcript:
Interviewer: Hello. I am calling from an independent monitoring team that reviews working conditions at ABC Construction. I am not calling on the company's behalf, and nothing you say will be reported back to them against your name. Would you be willing to answer a few questions?
Worker: Yes, okay.
Interviewer: Thank you. Before anything else, how old are you?
Worker: I am fourteen.
Interviewer: Thank you for telling me. I do not have any further questions for you today. Thank you for your time, and take care.
Worker: Okay, thank you.
